newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste, United Waste terms disappoint - arbs.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste, United Waste terms disappoint - arbs.

text.p: Terms of the proposed merger of United Waste Services Inc and USA Waste Services Inc disappointed traders on Monday, leading to a slump in the stocks, which rose last week in apparent anticipation of a deal, arbitrageurs said.
Still, they said the declines reflected short-term trading strategies, not market disapproval of the structure or rationale of the deal, which they expect to close as planned in the third quarter.
In early afternoon trade, United Waste shares were off five, or 13.3 percent, at 32-5/8, while USA Waste shares were down 3-1/4, or 9.2 percent, to 32.

Under the agreement, United Waste shareholders will receive 1.075 shares of USA Waste stock for each share held. Based on USA Waste's closing stock price on Friday, United Waste was valued at about $37.90 per share, or $1.7 billion.
Last Tuesday, United Waste shares reached a year-high of 41-3/4 from a recent low of $34 a share on April 2.
Also last Tuesday, USA Waste stock reached 37-1/4, close to the 52-week high of 38-7/8 attained in mid-March.
